bodega-at-stock: Single on-hand quantity per item and location
Sales order / release cannot skip stock when qty is short
Stock is reduced on goods issue, not on the sales invoice paper
benta-at-koleksyon: Sales Invoice and Official Receipt are separate documents
Collections record against open A/R, not chat screenshots
Delivery / load slip is not the same as billed
quotation-at-follow-up: CRM follow-up tasks can be scheduled from a quote
pagbili-at-supplier: Purchase request then purchase order with approval
Goods receipt then supplier invoice / A/P
serial-at-warranty: Serial registry tied to sales and receive
Warranty lookup from serial, not a notebook
vat-at-resibo: Tax types from Tax Management apply on quote and invoice lines
VAT-inclusive vs exclusive is a document setting, not a chat total
books-at-pagsara: One ledger; stock, OR, and bank must tie to the same books
Month-end uses posted documents, not three Excel files
after-sales: Repair orders and warranty from serial history
tindahan-pos: POS posts to the same stock and sales as the back office
blog: Same trading chain: quote, order, deliver, invoice, collect
